rows.text: calls the site `003B6C70` + 0x13 and, only when it returns non-zero, fills a stack block with qword 0x80 at `rsp+0x20`, dword 0xFF at `rsp+0x28` and byte 0 at `rsp+0x2F` and calls the site `003B6C70` + 0x37 with its address; on both paths it ends with the stack-cookie check (cookie from `01F44830` XORed with `rsp`) through the site `003B6C70` + 0x44
